name: Calendar Navigation
description: Horizontal full-month date strip with daysInMonth-day横向滚动, weekday labels, date numbers, and optional task indicator dots; each date cell is a rounded rectangle (radiusCard 18px); supports drag-handle to expand month view; container bg=surface, corner radius=radiusCardHeader(20px)

variants.name: Default DateStrip
variants.description: 整月 daysInMonth 天横向滚动日期条，每格显示周几标签 + 日期数字，可选任务圆点指示

variants.name: Month View Toggle
variants.description: DateStrip 底部附带 DragHandle(36x4, textTertiary@30%, radius2)，点击可展开为完整月历网格视图；收起时回到横向滚动条

states.name: selected
states.description: 选中日期：radiusCard(18px) 圆角矩形 + mintDeep (primary-500) 背景色 + 白色文字

states.name: today
states.description: 今日标记：mint (primary-100) 背景 50% 透明度 + ink 原色文字，区别于 selected 的实心 + 白文字

states.name: today-with-dot
states.description: 今日且有日程：在 today 状态基础上，日期下方显示 4x4 primary500 圆点指示任务

states.name: past
states.description: 过去日期：文字使用 textTertiary 色，视觉弱化

states.name: inactive
states.description: 非选中、非今日的普通日期默认态

states.name: drag-hover
states.description: 拖拽悬停时浅 primary 背景反馈，用于拖拽任务到日期时的目标指示
